summary_en: TT-PADM is a time-driven transformer diffusion model for recovering sparse-view and limited-view photoacoustic tomography images. The architecture substantially reduces transformer parameter count and is validated on simulated, in vivo mouse, and human-finger data, where it outperforms representative learning-based baselines and approaches full-view image quality.

summary_en: R-Flow applies a Radon-transform formulation to spatiotemporal ultrasound data to reconstruct axial and lateral microvascular flow vectors without injected contrast agents. The method is validated in simulations, phantoms, in vivo experiments, and a pilot human liver study, supporting quantitative microvascular-flow imaging over a broad velocity range.
